name: K4D
title: Elecraft K4D
summary: K4 with second ADC + BPF set: two independent 100 kHz–54 MHz receivers, diversity, 100 W, Ethernet remote.

f.band_scope: real-time panadapter + waterfall, per-RX hi-res mini-pan
f.roofing_filters: none (direct sampling); crystal filters only in K4HD KHDR4
requires: external ATU or KAT4 option for non-resonant antennas

extra.usb_note: USB-B = two virtual COM ports + USB audio
extra.lan_note: 100% Ethernet remote from 2nd K4 (K4/0) or PC/tablet incl. panadapter data
extra.supply_v: 12–15 VDC (K4D page; K4 FAQ says down to 11 V)
extra.io: 3× USB-A, USB-B, RS232, Ethernet, video out, LINE in/out, ACC, 12 V out
extra.upgrade_path: K4→K4D (KRX4/KDIV4 kit); K4/10→100 W (KPA4); K4HD (KHDR4 dual superhet) 'coming soon'; VHF/UHF ~15 W module planned
extra.ant_note: KAT4 option adds ATU + 3 antenna jacks; up to 5 RX antenna sources (medium on base jack count)
extra.dual_rx_note: KDIV4 option fitted: 2nd direct-sampling ADC + 2nd BPF set → receivers on different antennas, true diversity
extra.stability: ±0.25 ppm TCXO (K4D page; K4 page says ±0.1 ppm)
extra.variant: K4 + KDIV4 (KRX4) diversity option, factory assembled

gotchas: No internal ATU even at $7.2k — KAT4 extra; ico-ic-7610-32 (dual RX + ATU) and ysu-ftdx-101d include one for much less
Options make it expensive: K4D + KAT4 + MH4 + K-Pod lands near $8k (Elecraft's own packages); fri-flex-8600m is the closest dual-SCU peer
Still direct-sampling only — the superhet K4HD (KHDR4 crystal-filtered IF) for multi-op/contest-site overload is 'coming soon'; ysu-ftdx-101d / kwd-ts-990s are superhet dual-RX now
Needs a separate 13.8 V ~25 A supply; no mic in the box
HF+6m only — promised V/U module still not shipping
best_for: SO2V / split DX with independent antennas

pairs.why: no internal PSU; up to 23 A TX
ATU optional; 3 antenna jacks selectable per receiver
no mic included; required for SSB
diversity needs a 2nd antenna to matter
